title: Product Portfolio Architect
description:
**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

Our organization is embarking on a massive digital transformation journey: the E\&C ALign Program. By 2027, we aim to deliver a globally integrated digital system for E\&C. A core component of this transformation includes migrating our engineering design suite from SmartPlant to AVEVA, alongside
  

the deployment of a new ERP system (Sap/4Hana) and a Project \& Portfolio Management (PPM) tool.We are seeking a Product Portfolio Architect to act as the Coordinator during the critical Design, Build \& Deployment phases of the E\&C ALign Program. This role ensures that the technical specifications provided to our System Integrators (SIs) are cohesive across our four domains (Project
  

Management, Engineering, Sales\&Technologies, and Manufacturing/OT) and that the resulting architecture is robust, scalable, and fully maintainable when handed over to the DDS InnoTech for "Run Mode." The Product Portfolio Architect will also be acting for the harmonization of the business applications within InnoTech perimeter, and the initiation of the related projects.
1\. Manage Cross\-Domain Digital Solutions roadmaps


Bridging the E\&C ALign program and the InnoTech Core Business Domains.


Ensure with the Integration and Architecture team the overall architecture compliance and coherency.


Contribute to review and harmonize specifications sent to the System Integrator, ensuring that integrations between the new AVEVA suite, the ERP, and existing tools create a seamless "Digital Thread”.


2\. Ensure the Maintainability \& Operational Readiness of the portfolio


Ensure that the integrated solutions being built in the Align Program are manageable, supportable, and cost\-effective for the Core Business Domains team post\-Go\-Live.Execute the handover strategy from the project phase to the operational phase, including support models (processes and SLAs definitions), licensing considerations, and internal IT upskilling.


Identify and mitigate technical debts or over\-customizations proposed by System Integrators or E\&C Business representatives that could complicate the “run” phase and/or future software upgrades.


3\. Secure DDS delivery to the Align Program


Manage Leadership \& Stakeholder Management


Work in a matrixed environment under the guidance of the E\&C ALign IT Project Manager and the E\&C ALign Design Authority to ensure project milestones are met on time and within scope. Collaborate with Business Process Owners (BPOs) and the Design Authority to ensure the technical


architecture actually supports the targeted "One E\&C Mindset" global processes, and that the business requirements are not exceeding the actual needs. Apply Product Management principles to the integrated EPC toolset, treating the overarching IT ecosystem as a holistic product delivering end\-to\-end value. Liaise with the Architecture Director, the Head of the Core Business Domains, the EPC Program Director, the transversal services Director and DDS VP.


4\. Rationalize the Digital Solutions portfolio @ InnoTech


Serve as the forward\-looking integration lead to prepare for driving the strategic harmonization of IT applications when relevant.


Assess opportunities for consolidation, cost savings, and standardization with Domain Managers and Product Managers.


**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

Senior Leadership in IT: 7\+ years of experience in IT, with a strong background in heading digital products or acting as a Product Owner for internal enterprise suites. Large\-Scale Transformations: Proven track record of playing a lead technical or integration role in large, multi\-year IT transformation programs (ERP deployments, PLM implementations, etc.).


EPC Industry Expertise: Understanding of the EPC asset lifecycle.


Toolchain Knowledge: Familiarity with the complexities of migrating complex engineering data environments; specific experience with AVEVA (E3D, AVEVA Engineering) and/or Hexagon SmartPlant Suite is highly preferred.


Integration Fluency: Experience overseeing complex data integrations between Engineering design tools, Project Controls/Scheduling (e.g., Primavera), and Tier\-1 ERPs (e.g., SAP). Matrix Agility: Exceptional ability to lead by influence, managing the natural tension between aggressive project delivery goals and long\-term IT stability.


**Our Differences make our Performance**

  

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.
  

  

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

title: Import Export Manager
company: Mahesh Edible Oil Industries Ltd. Kota
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Import Export Manager** to drive international business development and export sales for the company. The role will primarily focus on **lead generation, identifying international buyers, developing new markets, generating export enquiries, converting prospects into customers, and achieving sales targets**.

**This is a sales and business development role and is not focused on operational import\-export documentation, logistics, or supply chain activities.**

Key Responsibilities

* Generate and develop **B2B export sales leads** across international markets.
* Identify and approach potential **importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers and institutional buyers**.
* Develop new international markets and expand the company's customer base.
* Conduct market research to identify countries, products, customer segments and business opportunities.
* Generate export enquiries through **LinkedIn, email campaigns, online platforms, references, trade databases and other business development channels**.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from **lead generation and initial contact to negotiation, order closure and customer relationship management**.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with international buyers and distributors.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate internally to provide suitable product and commercial proposals.
* Prepare quotations, commercial proposals and negotiate pricing and terms with customers.
* Follow up regularly with prospects and convert qualified leads into business.
* Maintain an updated database of international prospects, enquiries, follow\-ups and conversions.
* Monitor competitor activities, international market trends and pricing.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual **export sales and business development targets**.
* Explore opportunities for appointing distributors/agents in new international markets.
* Represent the company in relevant trade exhibitions, buyer meetings and international business events, when required.

Candidate Profile

* **5–6\+ years of experience in Export Sales / International Sales / International Business Development.**
* Experience in **FMCG, Edible Oil, Food Products, Agro Products or related industries** will be preferred.
* Strong experience in **B2B lead generation and international customer acquisition**.
* Proven ability to identify and develop new export markets.
* Strong understanding of international sales processes and customer negotiations.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Should be comfortable communicating with international clients through **email, phone, LinkedIn and online meetings**.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented with a strong business development mindset.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for business development, exhibitions and client meetings, as required.

Work Location: In person

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager-Jalandhar
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **International Wealth \& Premier Banking team.****Job Introduction :**
As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high\-net\-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans.
You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions.
Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients. **Principal Responsibilities** **HSBC Premier Relationship Manager****Business Impact:*** Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products

**Client Management:*** Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration:*** Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence:*** Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership \& Development:*** Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

 **Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements:** **Knowledge \& Experience*** Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Industry Experience: More than 5 years of relevant experience.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success \& experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high\-net\-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales \& Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licences and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit \& Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

 **Accreditations*** Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: AI Enterprise Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an **AI Enterprise Product Manager** to drive the next phase of evolution of our existing enterprise AI platform. The core platform and several major capabilities are already developed. The mandate for this role is to **enhance the product, improve user adoption, strengthen the subscription experience, identify product gaps and continuously evolve the platform based on customer usage and market requirements**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously evolve the **product roadmap** for an existing AI enterprise platform.
* Deeply understand the current platform, its capabilities, user journeys and architecture, and identify opportunities for **enhancement, simplification and better adoption**.
* Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, sales inputs and market developments into clearly prioritized product improvements.
* Improve the overall **user journey from signup and onboarding to activation, regular usage, subscription and expansion**.
* Enhance the platform's **subscription model**, including plans, feature entitlements, trials, upgrades, usage controls and monetization opportunities.
* Identify friction in the product and improve **self\-service adoption and time\-to\-value**.
* Work closely with engineering and AI teams to enhance existing capabilities and introduce new features without unnecessarily increasing product complexity.
* Evaluate whether customer requirements should become **reusable platform capabilities** rather than customer\-specific implementations.
* Define detailed **PRDs, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria and release priorities**.
* Own prioritization across **product enhancements, customer requirements, technical improvements and strategic platform capabilities**.
* Define and track key product metrics including **activation, feature adoption, trial conversion, paid conversion, retention, usage and expansion**.
* Use product analytics and customer behavior to identify underused capabilities, adoption bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular customer and user discovery to validate product decisions and identify emerging requirements.
* Work closely with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to ensure alignment between **product capabilities, packaging, positioning and customer expectations**.
* Continuously track developments across **Enterprise AI, AI agents, agentic platforms and enterprise SaaS** and translate relevant developments into product decisions.

**Required Skills** 

* Strong experience in **B2B SaaS or enterprise product management**.
* Strong understanding of **subscription\-based SaaS products**, including onboarding, trials, plans, entitlements, upgrades and usage\-based/product\-tier monetization.
* Good understanding of **enterprise software, workflows and business processes**.
* Practical understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents and agentic workflows**.
* Strong ability to evaluate an existing product and identify **UX, capability, adoption and monetization gaps**.
* Ability to distinguish between a **customer\-specific requirement and a scalable platform capability**.
* Strong experience with **product discovery, roadmap prioritization, PRDs, user stories and release management**.
* Understanding of SaaS/product metrics including **activation, conversion, retention, churn, engagement and expansion**.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams and understand **APIs, integrations, data flows and platform concepts**.
* Strong analytical, customer\-discovery and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate with significant ownership in a **fast\-moving product environment**.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or a related discipline**.
* **2–4 years of overall product management experience**, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Demonstrable experience managing and **evolving an existing software product or platform**, rather than only launching greenfield products.
* Experience working with a **subscription\-based SaaS product** with multiple plans or tiers.
* Experience improving **product adoption, onboarding, engagement and conversion**.
* Prior exposure to **AI/Generative AI, enterprise automation, workflow platforms or developer platforms** is strongly preferred.
* Experience taking a product from **early\-stage development to customer adoption and commercial scale** would be a significant advantage.
* Prior experience working with an **enterprise SaaS startup or product company** is preferred.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
